findings.title: Committed preimage reader accepts symlink blobs as regular source bytes
findings.observed: Git tree mode120000 linked.json resolves to a blob. The reader checks blob type and raw object SHA but not its tree mode, so returns link-target text actual.json. The filesystem reader rejects that same symlink.
findings.effect: Breaks the documented regular-source/symlink-rejection reader contract. It does not enable admission, approval, legacy replay or release in this inactive version. Caller-trusted immutable commit selection remains a separate documented requirement.
findings.recommendation: Resolve each exact tree path and require mode100644 or100755 with blob type. Bind returned batch OID/size to that tree entry; reject final/intermediate symlink, directory and gitlink fixtures. Keep this as a separate reviewed hardening change.
